purpose: Test whether a query-planned evidence-bounded ClayGraph selector can improve task-specific active knowledge assembly over the runtime deterministic packet-envelope baseline without increasing stale/shared-ancestry/graph-overreach errors.

dataset.includes: current branch mechanisms plus runtime policy and adversarial stale/refuted lexical decoys
dataset.gold_method: manually anchored to explicit source-supported dependencies; therefore not independent production ground truth

deterministic_packet_envelope.description: query-independent approximation of current preflight status/category/diversity ranking

g1_fixed_qualified_graph.description: qualified fixed one-hop graph activation derived from prior G1 direction

g1b_query_planned_hybrid.description: hybrid word/character lexical seed + query-class routing + 0/1/2 adaptive hop policy + qualified edge relevance gate + status filtering + evidence-family cap

anti_overfit_split.split: even-index 10 development queries / odd-index 10 held-out queries; only minimum relevance threshold tuned on development half
anti_overfit_split.interpretation: G1b does not improve held-out recall and slightly lowers held-out precision; it materially improves evidence-family coverage and stale suppression. This blocks promotion.

erroneous_edge_stress.injection: 12 random erroneous qualified edges per run using DEPENDS_ON/SUPPORTS/CONSTRAINS/IMPLEMENTS types
erroneous_edge_stress.interpretation: Relevance-gated adaptive routing is more robust to erroneous qualified edges in this constructed proxy.

negative_result: An earlier G1b variant with aggressive one-per-evidence-family suppression reduced recall to 0.5375. Anti-echo control must not become hard semantic amputation; duplicate ancestry should affect evidential counting/reranking, not blindly remove useful complementary descendants.
limitations: Not the repository's actual claygraph_build/query runtime
Gold and graph relations are source-grounded but hand-constructed
No SQLite/FTS execution over full repository
Local Python latency is not live FRANK latency
decision_effect: Supports G1b as a HOLD candidate and defines a stronger actual-corpus benchmark; does not justify replacing deterministic packet envelopes or accepted ClayGraph generation 0.
